strategies.entry_rule: Long when fast SMA exceeds slow SMA, evaluated on completed closes.
strategies.exit_rule: Exit when fast SMA <= slow SMA at next executable quote.
strategies.hypothesis: Trend persistence may outweigh turnover and spread costs.
strategies.failure_modes: Whipsaws, lag and corporate-action errors.
strategies.sizing: Deploy up to 100% of settled available cash; whole shares; actual fill capped by verified displayed size shared across participants. No invented margin or borrow.
strategies.objective: Highest net total return over one year; no risk-adjusted ranking.
